youtubeTitle: Nine bullets hit him in the 1965 war. He still won India's first Paralympic gold.
caption:
Nine bullets hit him in the 1965 war. He still won India's first Paralympic gold.

Murlikant Petkar was wounded by gunfire during the 1965 India-Pakistan war - hit by nine bullets, eight of which were removed, with one lodged deep in his spine leaving him paralyzed from the waist down. He took up swimming during his long recovery and at the 1972 Heidelberg Paralympics he won gold in the 50m freestyle with a world-record time of 37.33 seconds - India's first-ever Paralympic gold medal. He received the Padma Shri in 2018 and his life became the basis for the 2024 film 'Chandu Champion.'
